speaker: Devotee (bowing)
question: To whom bow — needing nothing, helping all?
premises: Bow to needing-no-service, sole helper of three worlds.
Of all desired, to desireless, to matted-haired.
inference: Bow to desireless helper of all, desired by all.

option_choices.reason: Needing-no-service (self-sufficient); admitting-no-service is same sufficiency, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (marveling)
question: What discernment sows devotion?
premises: Ah, this very discernment of the good for the great purpose.
Whereby these sow in you endless-fruited devotion, O lord.
inference: Good discernment sows endless devotion in you.

option_choices.reason: Faculty discernment (field-knowing as capacity); agent knower is same knower, T1 faculty kept.
They-sow (agricultural metaphor of devotion); establish is same planting, T1 sow kept.

speaker: Devotee (marveling at māyā)
question: How does māyā slacken the world?
premises: Ah, great is this māyā of yours, O wielder, veiled by which.
Even on gaining meditation-treasure on you, the bewildered people slacken.
inference: Your great māyā veils even treasure-gainers into slackness.

option_choices.reason: Slackens (grows lax in practice); releases letting-go is same laxity, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (asserting agency)
question: Who is the free doer?
premises: In every undertaking, O Bhava — act or means-and-rest or all, let be.
But the free doer therein alone is you.
inference: Amid all acts and means, you alone are the free doer.

option_choices.reason: In-undertaking (occasion of each act); in-beginning temporal is same onset, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (pleading rescue)
question: Whose power rescues the seized worlds?
premises: The three worlds seized by three-guṇa triple-throb dualities.
To rescue, other than you, whose is the power — or the grace?
inference: Seized worlds need your power or grace; none other's.

option_choices.reason: Grace-or (alternative to power); or-else is same alternation, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (inverting fault and greed)
question: What fault, what greed reaches you?
premises: What fault is fault in one set on reaching you? What virtue in one set on not reaching?
Let passion be mine resting in you alone; bow even to my greed whose prop is gaining you. (Upāya reading belongs to Kṣemarāja, never the root.)
inference: Fault aimed at you is no fault; even greed for you is bow-worthy.

speaker: Devotee (marveling at contemplation)
question: Who is made eligible by contemplation?
premises: Ah, great is this deed, O god, consisting of contemplation on you.
In which from Brahmā to worm, who of us is not made eligible for liberation?
inference: Contemplation on you makes all, worm to Brahmā, eligible.

option_choices.reason: Of-us (nas enclitic, of us with rhetorical who); na-not reading is same negation, T1 of-us kept.

speaker: Devotee (tracing works)
question: Whose are beginning, end, and between?
premises: Beginning of all works, end of all rites.
The various inner happenings between — yours indeed, O lord, on thought's path.
inference: All beginnings, ends, and betweens are yours on thought's path.

option_choices.reason: Various (manifold happenings); bright/strange is same citra, T1 various kept.
Of-thought (genitive singular, on thought's path); nominative thoughts plural is same dhiyaḥ, T1 genitive kept.

speaker: Devotee (tasting)
question: Where is devotion-nectar seen?
premises: While higher thousandfold expanse of taste.
Than your devotion-rasa-nectars, O lord, not elsewhere is seen.
inference: No taste elsewhere exceeds your devotion-nectar.

option_choices.reason: Higher (greater taste); later/answer is same uttara, T1 higher kept.
